items.title_zh: CVS 将分拆药房业务，医疗巨头大规模拆分；股价下跌 10%
items.summary_zh: 此举将逆转该公司对安泰 780 亿美元的收购，并拆解其在 2018 年打造的一体化医疗集团。

items.title: House Democratic leader Jeffries says he will legislate to block Trump's tariffs and end the Iran war; Brent crude falls 9.5 percent intraday to $93.74 a barrel
items.summary: US House Democratic leader Jeffries said Democrats will legislate to block Trump's tariff policy and to end the Iran war.
items.title_zh: 美国众议院民主党领导人Jeffries表示，将通过立法来阻止特朗普关税政策，并结束伊朗战争。 布伦特原油日内跌幅达9.5%，报93.74美元/桶
items.summary_zh: 美国众议院民主党领导人Jeffries表示，将通过立法来阻止特朗普关税政策，并结束伊朗战争

items.title: Kraft Heinz to divest its North American coffee business in $650 million deal
items.summary: Kraft Heinz will divest its North American coffee business to private equity firm One Rock Capital Partners as CEO Steve Cahillane works to revive the company.

items.title: Uber beats on revenue, CEO tells CNBC the company is 'investing significantly' to add drivers
items.summary: Uber reported better-than-expected revenue but its mobility unit faced higher fuel costs overseas and tighter driver supply.

items.summary_zh: 优步营收好于预期，但其出行部门面临海外燃油成本上升和司机供给趋紧的问题。
